+_PREC = {'+': 1, '-': 1, '*': 2, '/': 2, '%': 2, '^': 4}
+_UNARY_PREC = 3
+_OP_CHARS = frozenset('+-*/%^')
+_PUNCT = frozenset('(),')
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    tokens = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(formula):
+        c = formula[i]
+        if c.isspace():
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if c.isdigit():
+            j = i
+            while j < len(formula) and formula[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            if j < len(formula) and formula[j] == '.':
+                k = j + 1
+                if k < len(formula) and formula[k].isdigit():
+                    j = k
+                    while j < len(formula) and formula[j].isdigit():
+                        j += 1
+                    tokens.append(('NUMBER', float(formula[i:j])))
+                else:
+                    raise EvalError(f"invalid number: {formula[i:j+1]!r}")
+            else:
+                tokens.append(('NUMBER', int(formula[i:j])))
+            i = j
+            continue
+        if c.isalpha() or c == '_':
+            j = i
+            while j < len(formula) and (formula[j].isalnum() or formula[j] == '_'):
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(('NAME', formula[i:j]))
